conviction_note: No unpriced company-level number found. Q3 is new and the FY EBITDA range (EUR 680-760m) will probably be narrowed. Two public macro inputs lean toward the lower half: Brazil MOP has drifted below the mid-year level the midpoint assumes, and TTF gas is EUR 70-100 against a EUR 45 assumption. Peer counterparties (Nutrien, flat y/y realised potash, volume guide raised) and K+S's four straight consensus beats lean the other way. The stock has already fallen about 19% from 16.38 on 23 Sep, which is much more than any plausible trim to the midpoint. So the findings sum to -0.3, p_up is 49 and abs_move is 5.0: the size is real and the sign is a coin.

already_public.what: FY2026 EBITDA guide raised to EUR 680-760m (midpoint = full-year market expectation per the company). Adj. FCF guide mid-to-high double-digit EUR m, capex ~EUR 600m. H1 EBITDA EUR 455m (Q1 279, Q2 176)

Guide sensitivities: midpoint assumes Agriculture price level reached at mid-year held on average in H2; lower end includes Middle East effects and Werra low-water/cooling-water risk; gas at EUR 45/MWh for the ~30% bought spot
No ad-hoc (MAR Art. 17) from K+S since the 2026-06-09 convertible; the last results ad-hoc was the Q1 pre-release of 2026-04-22. Press release list shows nothing after 2026-09-14

new_in_release.expect: Q3 EBITDA, seasonally the weakest quarter (Q3/2025: EUR 111m vs Vara 105). Peers point to strong volumes and potash prices flat y/y; gas cost higher. Probably above prior year; versus the (unsourced) consensus, unknown with a slight beat lean given four straight beats

Likely narrowing of the EUR 680-760m range. Potash prices drifting below the mid-year level and gas well above EUR 45 lean toward the midpoint holding or the lower half. A cut below 680 is unlikely without an ad-hoc having been filed already
Adjusted FCF (H1 EUR 101m, missed Vara 119). Working capital and gas costs are a risk to the mid-to-high double-digit guide: unknown
First 2027 market commentary (potash supply, Belarus, Brazil demand). Qemetica closing still expected Q1 2027

findings.finding: Brazil granular MOP, the benchmark K+S names for its guidance midpoint, fell from a Q2 average of about $403/t to $396.5 (Jul), $386.9 (Aug) and $367.5 (Sep) on the World Bank series, and to $358-371 in late October (Nobel). That is below the 'mid-year price level held on average in H2' the midpoint assumes, so a narrowing toward the lower half is more likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raises moved the stock +8.65% (Q1 ad-hoc, 2026-04-22) and +2.28% (Q2 raise, 2026-08-12). The first 2026 guide on 2026-03-12 moved +14.8%. No guide cut in the observed window.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The stock fell from 16.38 (23 Sep) to 13.34 (sealed spot), with stock3 (2026-10-20) attributing it to 'die Entwicklung am Kalimarkt' and the Belarus deal. What would still be unpriced is how K+S itself translates the drift into the range. A proxy, not a company number.

findings.finding: European TTF gas went above EUR 70/MWh at end-August, EUR 90 on 20 Oct and EUR 100 on 28 Oct 2026, against K+S's EUR 45/MWh midpoint assumption for its ~30% spot gas. Management's own sensitivity (EUR 60 instead of 45 = a mid-single-digit EUR m) implies roughly EUR 10-20m of H2 cost over the assumption.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed release where gas cost alone moved the guide in 2026. The April 22 ad-hoc flagged Middle East energy and freight costs as a negative inside a raise and the stock rose +8.65%.
findings.why_not_priced: Gas prices are public and every analyst models them. The size is bounded by the company's own sensitivity, about 2% of the guide midpoint, so it moves where inside the range the guide lands, not whether the range breaks. If it were unpriced, consensus would still sit at the 720 midpoint after a 19% share-price fall, and that cannot be checked.
findings.independence: S&P Global: 'European gas price tops 100/MWh intraday' (2026-10-28), https://www.spglobal.com/energy/en/news-research/latest-news/natural-gas/102826-european-gas-price-tops-100mwh-intraday-ice . findings.finding: Counterparties that reported after K+S's last print say potash Q3 held up. Nutrien's Q3 2026 realised potash price was $275/t vs $277 a year earlier, volumes were 4.07mt vs 4.06mt, and it raised its FY potash volume guide to 14.3-14.8mt and kept 74-77mt global shipments. Argus has Brazil's Q3 potash imports at a record ~4mt. Together these point to a Q3 above the prior-year EUR 111m on volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Quarter beats have been bought only mildly: Q3/2025 beat (111 vs 105) +1.84%, Q2/2026 beat (176 vs 149) +2.28%. The Q1/2026 report, pre-released by ad-hoc, -1.23%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nutrien printed on 4 Nov and K+S rose from 12.98 to 13.36 over 4-6 Nov, so it is partly absorbed. K+S's mix is more European, with specialties and salt, so the read-through is a counterparty proxy. Mosaic's Q3 potash earnings dipped q/q ($189m vs $195m) and its Q4 MOP guide is $255-275, which argues against reading much into it.
findings.independence: Argus, 'Brazil's 3Q potash imports reach record 4mn t': https://argusmedia.com/ja/news-and-insights/latest-market-news/2615666-brazil-s-3q-potash-imports-reach-record-4mn-t ; Mosaic Q3: https://www.agnavigator.com/Article/2026/11/04/mosaic-posts/

findings.finding: K+S has beaten Vara consensus EBITDA on each of its last four prints: Q3/25 EUR 110.7m vs 105.1m, FY25 612.8m vs 603.4m, Q1/26 ~280m vs 225m, Q2/26 176m vs 149m. The sell-side has repeatedly lagged K+S's price realisation and cost discipline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats moved +1.84% (Q3/25), +14.8% (FY25 together with the first 2026 guide), +8.65% (Q1 ad-hoc with a raise) and +2.28% (Q2 with a raise). Beats with no guide change were muted.
findings.why_not_priced: A pattern, not a number. Analysts can see their own misses, and the last guide raise was explicitly set at the consensus midpoint, which removes some of the slack the earlier beats came from.

findings.finding: K+S itself built Werra low-water and cooling-water risk into the lower end of the 2026 range. The German drought persisted into autumn ('historisches Wasserdefizit'), but K+S has issued no production-interruption release since 12 Aug, where in 2018 it publicised each Werra stoppage.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed 2026 instance. Historic drought stoppages (2018) cost up to EUR 1.5m a day per Börsen-Zeitung.
findings.original_quote: So könnten Niedrigwasser und hohe Temperaturen in der Ulster und der Werra das Kühlwassermanagement im Werra-Werk schwieriger machen, erklärt das Unternehmen in eine Präsentation für Analysten. (Translation: low water and high temperatures in the Ulster and Werra could make cooling-water management at the Werra plant harder, the company explains in an analyst presentation.)
findings.why_not_priced: The risk is public and no curtailment was announced, so the expected cost is small. A curtailment that was never announced would be a negative surprise in the Q3 volumes. The silence of K+S's press channel makes that unlikely.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +2.7 (mostly the short-squeeze component on a 4.04% disclosed short, flat). Run-up is -4.1% at 20 days and -9.7% at 60. The findings net slightly negative on guidance and slightly positive on the quarter, so they neither confirm the positive lean nor cut hard against it. The 19% fall since 23 Sep already holds the macro negatives.
language_note: German WpHG voting-rights notices (EQS, filed in German only) carry Rossmann's share purchases into the drawdown, 6.42% to 7.06%, and its call-warrant expiries (20.11.2026, 18.12.2026); the English wires do not carry these
dpa-AFX German copy (cash.ch) carries the analyst-presentation detail that the LOWER end of the 2026 range includes Werra low-water and cooling-water risk; the English press release does not

German financial press (stock3, 2026-10-20) dates the 16% drawdown (16.38 to 13.69, 23 Sep to 19 Oct) and attributes it to the potash market and the US-Belarus deal; English sources had only the Belarus headline

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes median 9.0% vs 2.3%): a range narrowing is likely, so abs_move_pct went from 4.5 to 5.0. Not further, because 17 analysts, EUR 15m/day of turnover and this name's observed quarterly reactions of about 2% put it in the reiterate-or-narrow regime more than the cut-or-raise one

'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series / macro-to-company is a hypothesis': the Brazil MOP drift finding went from -0.6 to -0.4. The direct counterparty (Nutrien realised price flat y/y) partly contradicts the proxy
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus this name's muted reaction to beats without a guide change: the beat-pattern finding went from +0.3 to +0.2, and p_up stays near 50
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the Rossmann buying agrees with the positive short-squeeze lean, so it went from +0.2 to +0.1
'A German ad-hoc filed before the print may have pre-released the number': checked, none filed, so the quarter is new and not discounted. Recorded in already_public
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': FCF added explicitly to new_in_release as a risk line. No finding change
